title: Lowo Ufumene I-Surah
intro: Khawuthelekelele umphefumlo othobekileyo usondela komnye wabaThunywa baka-Allah unentliziyo ezele bubunyani kunye nomnqweno onzulu wokufunda. Kodwa ngelo xesha kanye, umntu osisityebi nohloniphekileyo wabamba ingqalelo yoMthunywa, waza wafinga iintshiya kulowo ufunayo. Okwalandela emva koko yayilisahluko esipheleleyo seQuran, esasithunyelwe ukulungisa uMthunywa nokuhlonipha umphefumlo ozayo ofuna.
clues: Ndeza kuMthunywa ka-Allah ndinentliziyo evulekileyo nomnqweno onzulu wokufumana ulwalathiso
Bendingenalo ilungelo lokubona ihlabathi, ndingumntu othobekileyo ofuna inyaniso kuphela
Amehlo am enyama ayengaboni, kodwa umbono wam wokomoya wawucacile
Ndifike ngexesha elingafanelekanga, xa uMthunywa wayexakeke ngumntu onempembelelo enkulu.
Ndathi shwaka, kodwa uAllah waphendula ngokulungiswa nguThixo.
NdinguAbdullah ibn Umm Maktum, iqabane elizinikeleyo ibali lakhe laphefumlela iSurah Abasa.
